cases.name: hook-timeout-fast-hook
cases.description: a hook that resolves before hookTimeoutMs behaves identically to no timeout at all

cases.name: hook-timeout-hung-attempt-with-timeout
cases.description: a hung onAttempt hook with hookTimeoutMs configured is swallowed and does not hang execute()

cases.name: hook-timeout-hung-give-up-with-timeout
cases.description: a hung onGiveUp hook with hookTimeoutMs configured is swallowed and does not hang the non-retryable failure path

cases.name: hook-timeout-hung-attempt-without-timeout
cases.description: a hung onAttempt hook with hookTimeoutMs unset hangs execute() forever

cases.name: hook-timeout-enter-call-unset
cases.description: a throwing enterCall hook is still swallowed via RetryCallFsm when hookTimeoutMs is unset

cases.name: hook-timeout-hung-retry-scheduled
cases.description: a hung onRetryScheduled hook is bounded and the scheduled retry proceeds
